brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full bases in a row (piece:0,-1,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:0,2,0;full), but only three hold planter bins (bin:0,-1,0, bin:0,1,0, bin:0,2,0, all hex-bin-third, soil-filled and planted). The middle cell 0,0 takes no bin: the configurator refused every bin there with PIPE_THROUGH_CELL because the run's pipe coupling sits in that cell.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 laid straight through all four bases at level 0 (start 0,-1 through 0,0, 0,1, 0,2), accepted in one op.

The pipe passes through every base, and three cells have planted bins beside it; but no bin, riser-fed tray or other watering outlet could be placed in cell 0,0 (bin refused PIPE_THROUGH_CELL, riser added then removed as it still blocked a bin), so that cell has no planted/watered volume. Also the configurator checks fit only, so actual water delivery/waterproofing cannot be verified.

finish.summary: Built a four-base row with a single straight water-pipe run (run:run-1) through all four bases at level 0, capped open faces and locked joints. Three cells carry third-depth planter bins filled with soil and planted. The middle cell (0,0) could not take any planter bin because the pipe coupling sits in that cell (PIPE_THROUGH_CELL refusal on all bin types, including -pvc), so it is a pipe pass-through cell only — hence compromise rather than built as asked.

lines.label: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 147 mm over 1 corner
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
buy 1 x 25 ft 3/4 in FLEXIBLE PVC, IPS, OD 26.67 mm (US), glues into Sch 40 sockets
- flexible legs are pool/spa grade hose: irrigation only, NOT potable and not for indoor plumbing
- glue with Weld-On 795 flexible-PVC cement and P-68/P-70 primer, not ordinary rigid cement
- keep every bend clear of its glued socket: the joint fails long before the pipe does
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
